name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your attached ADU, consider their experience with ADU projects specifically, as these have unique regulatory and design challenges. Look for contractors who are licensed, insured, and have a strong portfolio of completed work. Check their references and read reviews. Transparency in pricing, clear communication, and a strong understanding of local building codes in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine are also crucial for a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with ADU-specific experience, good references, transparent pricing, and knowledge of local building codes.
